lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: New Shoes. Peppa and George have been playing in the garden.
lines.zh: 新鞋子。佩奇和乔治一直在花园里玩。

lines.en: Peppa, where are your shoes? Oh, I've lost them. Well, I'm sure we can find them. Maybe we should try the garden.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你的鞋子呢？哦，我把它们弄丢了。嗯，我相信我们能找到。也许我们该在花园里找找。

lines.en: Yes. Everyone is looking for Peppa's shoes. Mummy Pig is looking in the flower bed. Peppa's shoes are not there.
lines.zh: 好。大家都在找佩奇的鞋子。猪妈妈在花坛里找。佩奇的鞋子不在那儿。

lines.en: Oh! Daddy Pig is looking in the wheelbarrow. Peppa's shoes are not there.
lines.zh: 哦！猪爸爸在手推车里找。佩奇的鞋子不在那儿。

lines.en: Oh! Peppa and George look in the flower pots. Peppa's shoes are not there, either.
lines.zh: 哦！佩奇和乔治在花盆里找。佩奇的鞋子也不在那儿。

lines.en: Oh. Oh, we've looked everywhere, but we can't find Peppa's shoes. Peppa's shoes are lost.
lines.zh: 哦。哦，我们到处都找过了，可就是找不到佩奇的鞋子。佩奇的鞋子丢了。

lines.en: Now I haven't got any shoes to wear.
lines.zh: 现在我没有鞋子穿了。

lines.en: Poor Peppa. Your shoes were getting a bit old. We'll buy you a new pair. Can my new shoes be red, Mummy? Of course they can.
lines.zh: 可怜的佩奇。你的鞋子有点旧了。我们给你买双新的吧。妈妈，我的新鞋可以是红色的吗？当然可以。

lines.en: George, I'm going to have new red shoes!
lines.zh: 乔治，我就要有新红鞋啦！

lines.en: Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Miss Rabbit's Shoe Shop. Hello, Miss Rabbit. Hello, Mummy Pig. We would like to buy some new shoes for Peppa, please. Red shoes.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和佩奇来到兔子小姐的鞋店。你好，兔子小姐。你好，猪妈妈。我们想给佩奇买双新鞋。红色的鞋。

lines.en: Oh, I'm sure we can find you some lovely new shoes. Peppa, red ones, please. Of course, red ones.
lines.zh: 哦，我肯定能给你挑到漂亮的新鞋。佩奇，要红色的。当然，红色的。

lines.en: Wow! New red shoes!
lines.zh: 哇！新的红鞋子！

lines.en: George and Daddy Pig are playing draughts. Oh, well done, George. Daddy! Daddy! Look at my new shoes. They're red!
lines.zh: 乔治和猪爸爸在下跳棋。哦，干得好，乔治。爸爸！爸爸！看我的新鞋。它们是红色的！

lines.en: I say, they are red. Mummy, do you like my new shoes? Yes, Peppa, they make you look very smart.
lines.zh: 哎呀，还真是红色的。妈妈，你喜欢我的新鞋吗？喜欢，佩奇，它们让你看起来很精神。

lines.en: George, do you like my new shoes?
lines.zh: 乔治，你喜欢我的新鞋吗？

lines.en: Everyone likes Peppa's new shoes. I like my new shoes so much, I don't want to ever take them off.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢佩奇的新鞋。我太喜欢我的新鞋了，我永远都不想脱下来。

lines.en: It is bath time. Peppa wants to keep her new shoes on, even for her bath.
lines.zh: 洗澡时间到了。佩奇想穿着她的新鞋，连洗澡也不脱。

lines.en: Peppa is in her pyjamas. She still has her new shoes on.
lines.zh: 佩奇穿上了睡衣。她还穿着新鞋。

lines.en: Peppa even wants to wear her new shoes in bed. Peppa, are you sure you don't want to take your shoes off? I don't want to ever take my new shoes off, Mummy.
lines.zh: 佩奇甚至想穿着新鞋睡觉。佩奇，你确定不想把鞋脱下来吗？妈妈，我永远都不想脱下我的新鞋。

lines.en: Very well. Good night, Peppa and George. Good night, Mummy. Good night, Daddy. Good night, my little piggies.
lines.zh: 那好吧。晚安，佩奇和乔治。晚安，妈妈。晚安，爸爸。晚安，我的小猪们。

lines.en: It has been raining all night, and now the garden is very wet. Mummy Pig is wearing her boots. Daddy Pig is wearing his boots. George is wearing his boots. Peppa is still wearing her new red shoes.
lines.zh: 下了一整夜的雨，现在花园里很湿。猪妈妈穿着她的靴子，猪爸爸穿着他的靴子，乔治也穿着靴子。佩奇还穿着她的新红鞋。

lines.en: George is going to play in the wet grass.
lines.zh: 乔治要在湿漉漉的草地上玩。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Peppa loves playing in the wet grass, but she doesn't want to get her new shoes wet. I can't play in the wet grass, George.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。佩奇喜欢在湿草地上玩，可她不想把新鞋弄湿。乔治，我不能在湿草地上玩。

lines.en: Oh! George loves jumping in muddy puddles. Peppa loves jumping in puddles, but she doesn't want to get her new shoes muddy.
lines.zh: 哦！乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳。佩奇也喜欢跳泥坑，可她不想把新鞋弄脏。

lines.en: Ah! Mummy and Daddy love jumping up and down in muddy puddles. Everyone likes jumping in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 啊！猪妈妈和猪爸爸喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下。大家都喜欢在泥坑里跳。

lines.en: Where is Peppa going?
lines.zh: 佩奇要去哪儿？

lines.en: Peppa is putting on her boots. Wee!
lines.zh: 佩奇穿上了她的靴子。哇！

lines.en: If you jump in muddy puddles, you must wear your boots.
lines.zh: 如果你要跳泥坑，就必须穿上靴子。
